https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/wiki/RStan-Mac-OS-X-Installation-Instructions

beginners can follow along.

- Bob

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: Mac OS X Install Instructions for RStan
parts:
I still think the last step should just be

source("http://mc-stan.org/install_rstan.R", echo = TRUE)

and have all that stuff be in a world readable file called install_rstan.R on mc-stan.org. That will enable us to tweak install_rstan.R if necessary and also avoid the need to keep the wiki in sync for three different platforms.

Ben
